findings.quote: It is half hers now, too.
findings.claim: R3 says the wooden treehouse observatory belongs to [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] and Marcos jointly, and neither may promise or lend it without the other saying yes. This line has Marcos unilaterally declare Elena a co-owner, which is not a permission either grandfather can grant alone under R3 -- and goes beyond the outline's beat 2, which has Marcos simply say yes to being shown the observatory.
findings.fix: Marcos gives a plain yes to the question actually asked -- permission to show Elena the observatory -- without declaring any change of ownership.
